description: Reviews API: List Booking.com reviews. Guest reviews of a Booking.com property as `Review` objects (scores out of 10): what the guest liked and disliked, room, nights, stay dates, traveller type and the property's reply. Booking.com applies sort, language, score band, traveller type, season and text search; `since` and `until` are applied on each page. `meta.entity` is the property. A page that returns nothing only because of the filters, with `has_more` true, is free. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

hotel_id.description: Property ID: `<country>-<page name>`, or the numeric ID returned by the search (`id`, e.g. `537945`)

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 25, one page of the source)

score.description: Score band: superb 9+, good 7-9, passable 5-7, poor 3-5, very_poor 1-3

season.description: Time of year of the stay

name: reviews_booking_hotel_reviews
title: List Booking.com reviews
